user.title: Sign in to Magna iPortal
user.description: Enter your credentials for iportal.magna-energia.sk (the same ones as for the Magna customer portal).

point.title: Metering point
point.description: This account has several metering points. Pick the one to track — you can add the others as separate integrations.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: iPortal rejected the login for {username}. Enter the password again.

error.cannot_connect: iPortal did not respond. Try again later.

abort.already_configured: This metering point is already configured.
abort.no_points: No metering point was found on this account.

init.title: Lending balance
init.description: The portal does not publish the lending balance — only the monthly flow in and out. Enter the absolute level once from your invoice (Zostatok do nasledujúceho obdobia) and it is tracked from there. Note: the value is an estimate — only surplus delivered at positive spot prices is banked and the portal does not distinguish it, so re-enter this after every invoice. Leave empty if you do not want to track it.
